title: MAGIC ENGLISH BEGINNER — WORLD 6: A1 SPEAKING & STORY POWER
description: High-density A1 practice focused on connected speech, stories, practical conversations, reading comprehension, guided writing and independent response.

missions.title: Question Master
speaking: Answer 15 everyday questions in complete sentences.
listening: Identify question words and key information.
missions.challenge: Ask five follow-up questions without translation.

missions.title: My Best Friend
reading: Read a short profile and identify details.

missions.title: Yesterday Was Busy
missions.challenge: Sequence a past-day story with first, then, after that, finally.

missions.title: Weekend Adventure
speaking: Retell the story in your own words.

missions.title: Future Plans
speaking: Talk about five plans for next week.
missions.challenge: Ask and answer six future-plan questions.

missions.title: Phone Call Mission
missions.real_life: Leave a simple message with name, reason and callback request.

missions.title: At the Hotel
listening: Identify name, room and number of nights.

missions.title: Airport English
speaking: Ask for a gate and flight time.
listening: Understand simple airport announcements and instructions.
missions.real_life: Complete a guided airport information role-play.

missions.title: Online English
missions.challenge: Give clear step-by-step instructions for a simple digital task.

missions.title: Conversation Lab: Three Minutes
listening: Follow a two-speaker A1 conversation and identify details.
missions.challenge: Keep the conversation going using follow-up questions.

missions.title: Reading Detective
reading: Find main idea and supporting details.
Use context to understand unfamiliar easy words.
speaking: Explain the story using your own words.
writing: Answer comprehension questions in complete sentences.
missions.challenge: Find evidence in the text for five answers.

missions.title: Listening for Details
listening: Extract names, numbers, times, places and reasons.
speaking: Report five details from the recording.
missions.challenge: Listen twice: first for gist, second for exact information.

missions.title: Writing My Day
writing: Write a 12–15 sentence paragraph about your day.
Use a clear beginning, middle and ending.
missions.challenge: Improve five sentences by adding time, place or reason.

missions.title: Story Builder
speaking: Create and tell a short story from six picture prompts.
writing: Write 12 connected sentences with beginning, problem and solution.
listening: Identify story structure in a short model.

missions.title: Polite English Power
speaking: Transform direct requests into polite requests.
missions.real_life: Use polite English in shop, café, hotel and school situations.

missions.title: Real-Life Problem Solver
missions.challenge: Complete four emergency-free everyday problem scenarios in English.

missions.title: A1 Speaking Marathon
speaking: Speak for 30 seconds on six topics.
Speak for 60 seconds on two topics.
listening: Understand follow-up questions at natural A1 speed.
missions.challenge: Speak continuously without translating or reading a script.

missions.title: A1 Natural Listening Mission
listening: Understand 2–3 minutes of clear natural A1 speech.
Identify main idea, sequence and key details.
Recognize familiar phrases at normal speed.
missions.challenge: Summarize what you heard in five complete sentences.

missions.title: English-Only Mission
speaking: Describe, explain and choose without translation.
reading: Read a connected A1 passage and answer in English.
writing: Write 15 connected sentences on a familiar topic.
missions.challenge: No translation support during the final response round.

missions.title: WORLD 6 FINAL MASTER QUEST — A1 COMMUNICATION
speaking: Complete hotel, airport and problem-solving role-plays.
listening: Understand 3 minutes of clear natural A1 English and extract gist plus details.
reading: Read a 300-word A1 text and answer comprehension questions.
writing: Write a 15–18 sentence connected personal or story text.
missions.challenge: Complete a full English-only A1 mission combining listening, speaking, reading, writing and real-life role-play.
missions.mastery_target: Learner can communicate in familiar everyday situations, describe people and routines, discuss simple past and future plans, understand clear connected speech, read short texts and write connected A1 paragraphs.

world_review.mastery: Strong A1 communication with increasing independence and reduced reliance on translation.
